parameters.description: Call this tool for quering the marketing trends and knowledge such as marketing techniques, and marketing strategies or methods for TikTok and influencer KOL or KOC marketing strategy would like to apply into the campaign through ai-based web research and get latest knowledge or research such as how it works, use cases, benefits, guidelines, pros & cons and so on.

contentIdeations: Showcase the product in unboxing videos, highlighting its eco-friendly packaging and features.
Create detailed reviews of the product, emphasizing its effectiveness in cleaning tough stains and its safety for families.
Demonstrate how to use the product in various cleaning scenarios, such as kitchen counters or bathroom tiles.
Share personal stories or testimonials about how the product has made cleaning easier and more sustainable.
Feature the product in day-in-the-life vlogs, showing how it fits into a parent's laundry routine.
Create a challenge video, such as 'Can this detergent remove tough baby stains in one wash?'.
Show before-and-after comparisons of baby clothes washed with the product.
Host a Q&A session answering common questions about the product's safety and effectiveness.
Produce tutorial videos on how to use the product for different types of dishes and kitchenware.
Compare the product with conventional dishwashing liquids, highlighting its eco-friendly benefits.
Share behind-the-scenes content of the product's production process to emphasize its sustainability.
Encourage users to share their own videos using the product, creating a community around eco-friendly cleaning.

output.practiceDescription: Emphasize the USDA-certified bio-based and vegan-friendly features of ReadyCare Signature products. KOCs should showcase how these products contribute to a sustainable lifestyle, appealing to environmentally conscious consumers in Malaysia.

Demonstrate the multiple uses of ReadyCare products, such as the Biobased Multipurpose Cleaner for various surfaces or the Biobased Baby Laundry Detergent for delicate fabrics. This helps potential buyers see the value in one product.

KOCs should share personal experiences or testimonials about using ReadyCare products, such as how the Biobased Dishwashing Liquid made their dishes sparkle or how the Baby Laundry Detergent is gentle on their child's skin.

Incorporate trending sounds, challenges, or hashtags on TikTok to increase visibility. For example, create a 'cleaning hack' video using the Biobased Multipurpose Cleaner to align with popular content themes.

Show the effectiveness of ReadyCare products through before-and-after clips. For instance, compare dirty dishes cleaned with the Biobased Dishwashing Liquid or stained clothes washed with the Baby Laundry Detergent.
Invite followers to try ReadyCare products and share their experiences. KOCs can run a giveaway or challenge where participants post their own reviews or cleaning results using a branded hashtag.

Highlight the hypoallergenic and skin-friendly properties of ReadyCare products, especially for baby care items. KOCs can reassure parents about the absence of harsh chemicals in the Biobased Baby Laundry Detergent.
End videos with a strong CTA, such as 'Swipe up to shop now' or 'Comment below for a chance to win a free trial pack.' This drives engagement and conversions for the giveaway campaign.

angle: Eco-conscious consumers looking for sustainable cleaning solutions
Parents seeking safe and natural baby care products
Pet owners who prioritize eco-friendly pet care
Showcasing the benefits of bundling eco-friendly products
Highlighting cost savings with bundle deals (Buy 1 Free 1, Buy 2 Free 3, Buy 3 Free 5)
Demonstrating real-life use cases of the bundled products

output.recommendationHeadline: Encourage KOCs to tag ReadyCare Signature in their TikTok posts
output.practiceDescription: Ensure KOCs include @ReadyCareSignature in their captions and video descriptions to link back to the brand's TikTok account.
output.recommendationDescription: This practice increases brand visibility and allows the KOC's audience to easily discover ReadyCare Signature's TikTok profile.

output.practiceDescription: Collaborate with KOCs to incorporate trending and niche-specific hashtags like #EcoFriendlyCleaning and #BioBasedProducts in their posts.
output.recommendationDescription: Hashtags enhance discoverability and attract a broader audience interested in sustainable cleaning solutions.

output.practiceDescription: Share snippets or behind-the-scenes content of the KOC collaboration on Instagram, Facebook, or YouTube, linking back to the TikTok post.
output.recommendationDescription: Cross-promotion maximizes reach and engages audiences across multiple social media platforms.

output.practiceDescription: Track engagement metrics such as views, likes, shares, and comments to evaluate the success of the KOC collaboration.
output.recommendationDescription: Data-driven insights help refine future influencer marketing strategies and improve ROI.
